title: Safety and effectiveness of the SUPRACOR presbyopic LASIK algorithm on hyperopic patients
indication: hyperopia (sphere +0.0 D or more) with presbyopia (reading add 1.0 D or more); only the standard hyperopic LASIK eyes are extracted

groups.description: Group B dominant eyes treated with standard hyperopic LASIK (18 eyes of 18 patients); laser and flap details are stated for Supracor eyes only; the fellow non-dominant eyes received Supracor (excluded)

series.notes: mean ± SD; per-visit n of Group B not reported (Tab2 shows fewer Supracor eyes at later visits)

exclusions.what: All Supracor-treated eyes: Tab2 (all Supracor eyes) and Tab3 Group A dominant and non-dominant, Group B non-dominant and Group C non-dominant columns
exclusions.reason: presbyopic Supracor profile with a recommended -0.50 D SE target (non-plano target)
post-enhancement outcomes of four retreated Supracor eyes (retreatment)
preoperative summaries of the Supracor-treated eyes by patient group

exclusions.what: Fig. 4-5 (intended versus achieved SE, refractive accuracy)
exclusions.reason: attempted-versus-achieved plots and proportions are not admissible

notes: Target of the standard LASIK dominant eyes is not stated (the -0.50 D recommendation applies to Supracor); recorded unstated.
Retreatments (four eyes) concerned Supracor eyes only.
Retrospective review with a minimum follow-up of 1 month.
Monocular and binocular visual acuity (Tab1, Tab4-6), corneal topography and higher-order aberrations are reported but not extracted.
